profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV. Its Spanish site presents the brand as a 100% electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and says the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. The models listed there are the G6, G9 and P7+, which the site says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform. According to the site, that platform allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range, all three models carry the DGT CERO label, and the warranty runs up to 7 years / 160.000 km.

The site's AI claim is limited to stating that the models combine artificial intelligence with advanced driver assistance systems. No AI products are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded.

The Spanish site also carries commercial and administrative detail. It names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries submitted through the page, and states that financing is offered by Open Bank, S.A. One example given is the G6 RWD Standard Range, with a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €, an opening commission of 3,50 % and a debtor rate of 1,99% T.A.E. 3,53%.
